quests.title: Anomaly: Inazuma

dialogue.section: Check out the situation on Tsurumi Island

dialogue.t: Miko? We weren't expecting to see you here!
Hehe, I'm only teasing you. You're so obedient.
Someone reported to me that there had been some unusual activity in this area.
I immediately drew a fortune slip... and the result was "Great Misfortune." So I thought I'd better come and see for myself.
Yeah, Paimon has to agree that this whole situation seems kinda ominous... So, what do you think, Lady Guuji? Do you have any sense of what's going on?
Mmm... I'm not sure. Who knows what trick the Heavenly Principles might be playing.
I can faintly sense a power of some sort... I'll have to drag little Kokomi here when I get the chance. Maybe she'll be more familiar with it.

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
